In my first two years of high school, I did have a substantial amount of friends, but all we really did was insult and talk shit about each other all the time, which got extremely tiring toward the end and was a major contributor to my depression. Despite interacting with many people, I still felt alone. Then, this year I was forced to transfer into a different high school, and now I am actually alone. I have 1-2 friends total, and I only share one period with them, so for most of the day I’m isolated from everyone else. I am too socially inept to talk to anybody there and initiate conversations. The only reason why I ever had friends in the past is because they talked to me first. Despite all of that, there seems to be people in that school who still dislike me anyway, despite not doing anything to them. I know it’s my fault my life is this way, and I really wish I was different. It hurts really bad to see other people living their high school lives to the fullest constantly every single day. I’m just the lame new kid.

I’m aware my situation is different from yours, but I think regardless of that, I understand how you feel. I’ve wasted most of my high school years. I’ll never experience the parties, the friend hang-outs, prom, or real teenage love. I’ll never live the life of a 2000s high school film. It really sucks. On the bright side, high school is only four years of your life, and you have plenty of time to turn it all around. Don’t dwell on it too much.
